name: MMMU-Pro
intro: MMMU-Pro是MMMU基准的强化版本，通过剔除文本模型可解答的问题、扩展候选选项，并引入仅视觉输入的设置（问题嵌入图像中），严格评估多模态模型的真实理解与推理能力。结果显示模型在MMMU-Pro上的表现显著下降，提供了更严苛的多模态AI评测工具。
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
eval_feature: 对抗性, 思维链, 领域特定
intro_en: MMMU-Pro is an enhanced version of the MMMU benchmark that strictly evaluates multimodal models' true understanding and reasoning abilities by removing questions solvable by text-only models, expanding candidate options, and introducing a vision-only setting (with questions embedded in images). Results show a significant performance drop on MMMU-Pro, providing a more rigorous multimodal AI evaluation tool.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2409.02813, Sections 2-3. MMMU-Pro starts from MMMU's 11.5K questions across 30 subjects. Four text-only LLMs answer each item ten times without images; a model marks a question answerable when correct more than five times, and the item is removed when at least three of four models pass. The authors sample 1,800 remaining items evenly at 60 per subject. GPT-4o generates additional distractors, Claude 3.5 filters them, and two human-review rounds refine option quality, diversity, and image relevance; removing 70 invalid items leaves 1,730 questions with up to ten choices. Annotators manually capture each question as a photo or screenshot with varied display conditions, producing 1,730 standard and 1,730 vision-only representations, 3,460 in total. Models are evaluated in the ten-option standard and vision-only settings with Direct and CoT prompts; the higher result is used, and overall accuracy averages the two settings. OCR is analyzed by normalized Levenshtein similarity alongside CoT and error effects.
